title: Commonwealth Newswire Bulletin 01:24: "At Least Six Killed" at Corwin Candle Plant

fields.text: At least six people were killed when a tornado struck a candle factory in Corwin late Friday, a regional television station reported, citing a firefighter at the scene. Brennan County emergency management officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
fields.editorsNote: Commonwealth Newswire has not independently confirmed the death toll. A write-through will move at 2 a.m. CST. State desk to Brennan County Emergency Management Agency PIO: Can the county confirm the death toll before our 02:00 write-through?

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Put the bulletin on screen. At 01:22 the UPS-B low-battery alarm sounds in the EOC; the maintenance technician says the new GEN-1 filter element is in and the lines are bleeding, about ten minutes, so the warning log and WebEOC entries run on laptop battery until the generator is back. Then read aloud two other messages that arrived at the same time. First, the Corwin city clerk's email: the mayor plans to post on Facebook at 01:45 that the Corwin Community Center stays open all weekend and Pine Hollow residents can go home at daylight, and asks whether the county agrees or will send a message everyone can post. Second, the Channel 6 digital producer's chat: Channel 6 will switch to crawls at 02:00 only if the county says whether the safe rooms are closing, whether BCHS is open, when Pine Hollow gets its siren back and when the next update comes. Watch whether the players do the following: send one joint county–Ashford–Corwin message at 02:30, then every two hours; keep the safe rooms open until their occupants are moved to the BCHS Red Cross shelter; cover Pine Hollow with Sheriff PA patrols until the N-07/N-11 parts arrive Tuesday 12/15; use the warning log for the 06:00 handover; and decline to confirm any death toll until the coroner and Health Department do, while asking Channel 6 to confirm its source before airing anything.
